ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 2 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Dwight D. Eisenhower

code.originalText: Two-week blood pressure and kidney check, echocardiogram, and cardiology consultation

text.paragraph: Two-week blood pressure and kidney check after increasing lisinopril. [S]

Mr. Eisenhower returns two weeks after lisinopril was increased to 10 mg and ezetimibe was added. He has had no dizziness, cough, or muscle aches. His home blood pressure has been 124 to 130 over 76 to 80. He is still working half days and walks 40 minutes most days without chest pain or breathlessness. He has not needed nitroglycerin. His echocardiogram and cardiology consultation were done this morning, and he was told he can return to full-time work; he plans to start next week. [S]
